records.text: In Play Like a Fangirl, Christine (book co-author; surname unverified), Ashley Brown Guajardo, and Tanya (book co-author; surname unverified)—these are the authors—are going to look at the collective efforts of such fans to create meaningful and arousing connections to video game worlds, to characters, and to one another, using pleasure as a lens. They show how fans' playful practices both reflect current cultural values and shape how we relate to video games and ourselves.
